title: Gate 2 contrast table: every color token on every surface it may sit on
author: Accessibility lead, Gate 2 task 5

method.formula: WCAG 2.2 contrast ratio (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), relative luminance from sRGB with the 0.04045 linear threshold; pass or fail is decided on the unrounded ratio, and the table prints it to two decimals
method.inputsNote: The token files are byte for byte those at commit 043ad4d8, which built the frozen page
method.themes: Light is Newsprint (the default and data-oa-theme="light"); dark is Charcoal (prefers-color-scheme: dark, or data-oa-theme="dark"). White and Prussian are surface classes that keep their surface in either theme.
method.placement: Each semantic, chart and component token is measured against the surface its name and $extensions give, or against the ground its $extensions name (a label on its fill, a bar on its band), plus every second ground listed in groundsAlso. Each ground (field, selected band, Error Band) is measured with every text token its textOnIt names. Derived colors and tints are measured on every surface their surfaces list names. Opacity watermarks are composited over their ground.
